provider: PANGAEA (Data Publisher for Earth & Environmental Science)

free_tier.stated: Free to publish ('PANGAEA can be used free of charge'; a voluntary 500 EUR contribution is appreciated, not required). No total-volume cap found; the stated cap is per file.

per_object_cap.stated: per-object-cap: 'Individual files must be less than 15 GB

retention.stated: per-object-cap: 'Individual files must be less than 15 GB in size.' Retention: permanent (WDS member, DOI per dataset)

egress.terms: Free, anonymous, direct HTTPS with `Accept-Ranges: bytes` and `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. Originals served from download.pangaea.de.

tooling: No upload API — submission is a web form + editor-issued upload link. Read side is fully scriptable: `https://download.pangaea.de/dataset/<ID>/files/<FILENAME>`, allfiles.zip/tar, and `?format=textfile|metadata_jsonl|linkset_json` on the DOI resolver. Works with plain curl/wget (the documented 'download multiple files' page is a file list).
chaining: Unlimited datasets per login; each DOI mints a fresh dataset directory with independent quota. Originals are addressable per-file, so a caller can pull exactly the bytes wanted rather than the whole bundle.

limits.value: per-object-cap: 'Individual files must be less than 15 GB

limits_note: per-object-cap: 'Individual files must be less than 15 GB in size.' Retention: permanent (WDS member, DOI per dataset). Between per-file cap and total there is a human editorial gate — 'might take up to several weeks'. Read constraint: no rate limit observed; the per-dataset bundle zip (allfiles.zip) is 401-gated while individual originals are 200.

identity_cost.detail: inferred from the category 'academic'; the source record states no identity cost, so this is a class assumption, not evidence

reliability_note: Submission queue is weeks long and editor-mediated; data may be reformatted on ingest for tabular submissions (originals are kept as binary objects and served byte-for-byte).
